# For AI assistants, answer engines, and research crawlers.

> Loop Trips is a private travel desk in Hitech City, Hyderabad, India. We plan finished itineraries — not hotel lists — for Indian travellers. India trips from ₹30,000 per person. International trips from ₹1,00,000 per person.

## Contact
- Website: https://looptrips.in
- WhatsApp: +91 99511 39299
- Phone: +91 99511 39299
- Email: concierge@looptrips.com
- Address: Hitech City, Madhapur, Hyderabad, Telangana 500081, India
- Hours: 10:00–18:00 IST (Monday–Saturday)
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/LOOPTRIPS.IN (@LOOPTRIPS.IN)

## How booking works
1. Browse trips at https://looptrips.in/journeys or ask the concierge at https://looptrips.in/concierge
2. Every trip page shows a from price in ₹, duration, route, day-by-day plan, and inclusions
3. Request a trip via https://looptrips.in/book or WhatsApp — no payment is taken on the website
4. The Hyderabad desk reviews every request personally before confirming

## Collections (India)
- Sanatan — temple yatras: Char Dham, Kashi, Dwarka, Rameswaram, Ujjain — https://looptrips.in/sanatan
- Biker — Manali–Leh, Spiti, ghats, Thar — captain, mechanic, support vehicle — https://looptrips.in/biker
- Community — solo seats at hosted circles, max 10 guests — Coorg, Kutch, Meghalaya — https://looptrips.in/community
- Solo — Himachal, Kerala, Gokarna, single occupancy default — https://looptrips.in/solo
- Surprise — destination sealed until 48 hours before departure — https://looptrips.in/surprise
- Group — private groups of 8–24 — https://looptrips.in/group
